pages.text: The armour and weapons of the myths have powers the plain game lacks. They show in the item's tooltip and add up over everything you wear.
Reflection: that share of a melee blow strikes the attacker back.$(br)Lifesteal: that share of the damage you deal heals you.$(br)Monster slaying: more damage to the creatures and gods of the myths.
Divine ward: less damage from the creatures and gods of the myths.$(br)Evasion: a chance that a blow or an arrow misses.$(br)Fury: more damage while you are at half health or less.
